description:
Every named entity is present exactly as filed; nothing has dissolved. Re-verified
at main 417c5b0b5.

Both PullSession side channels still exist, still structural twins
(src/compiler2/pull.rs:811-822):

    return_demand_contributions / return_demand_contributors / return_demands
    input_demand_contributions  / input_demand_contributors  / input_demands

The imperative invalidation this ticket wants deleted is still there:

    pull.rs:1092  replace_settled_return_demand_contributions
    pull.rs:1123  recompute_return_demand
    pull.rs:1178  replace_settled_input_demand_contributions
    pull.rs:1209  recompute_input_demand

`TargetDemandContribution` -- the coupling that forces the two to move together
-- is at jobs/runtime_demand.rs:515, used at :506, :643, :809, :823.

The SCC-internal solver itself is `settle_demand_cone`
(jobs/runtime_demand.rs:563, called from :370).

## The prerequisite still does not exist

No settled-GROUP epoch fact primitive: `FactKey` (drive.rs:88-120) has no
group/epoch/SCC variant, and `ClaimShape::is_cumulative` (drive.rs:126-129) knows
only ReturnType and ActivationInputs.

## Standing position

This matches [[feedback_scc_inner_solver_is_tolerated_debt]]: the SCC-settled
demand solver is a REMOVAL TARGET, not a precedent to extend. "Consistent with
that precedent" justifies nothing here.

Coordinate with fz-kdt.4 (the demand cone is the whole call graph) -- both are
about the same solver, and fz-kdt.4's stratification question may determine
whether this dissolution is even needed or whether the cone stops being one blob
first.

Line drift: `settle_demand_cone` was cited via runtime_demand.rs:286-323 in the
sibling ticket; it is now :563.
title: Dissolve the SCC-internal demand solver; its prerequisite settled-GROUP epoch fact does not exist
